name: Shadow Copy Deletion Attempt via Vssadmin
description: Detects execution of vssadmin.exe attempting to delete shadow copies, a hallmark of ransomware preparation.
explanation: Ransomware operators routinely execute 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' to prevent disaster recovery via Volume Shadow Copies.
investigation_steps: Immediately inspect all active processes under the parent PID.
Review file modification rates across all drives for ransomware encryption activity.
Verify backup integrity on isolated storage.
